items.title: Announcing in-place upgrades from Standard brokers to Express brokers for Amazon MSK
items.summary: Amazon MSK now supports in-place upgrades from Standard brokers to Express brokers. You can modernize an existing MSK Provisioned cluster through a fully managed workflow, with no new cluster, no application changes, and no downtime. This post shows how to assess readiness, run the rolling upgrade, validate, and roll back if needed.
items.creator: Ankita Mishra
categories: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)

items.title: How Twilio modernized billing at 70% lower cost with Amazon Redshift
items.summary: How Twilio's Commerce Platform team modernized their billing pipeline on Amazon Redshift Serverless, cutting infrastructure costs 70% and speeding billing recalculations 12x with streaming ingestion from Amazon MSK and Zero-ETL from Amazon Aurora MySQL.
items.creator: Sean McKibben
